title: Generate the server scrubber word list from the catalogue
evidence: Step 1 (PR 1376): the word lists and regexes both scrubbers share live in packages/health-core/src/scrub-vocabulary.ts, derived from the catalogue. Step 2 (PR 1484): instrument-scrub.mjs is generated from health-core's sentry-scrub-server.ts by tools/generate-instrument-scrub.mjs (esbuild); a stand-in catalogue carries the finished lists, so the file holds none of lab-catalog's graph. 2026-11-26 (Brad): sentry-scrub-server-parity.test.ts is retired. Its output-parity comparison, which compared the source with its own output, is gone; its four shape checks (the two scrub files' imports, sentry-scrub.ts's export list, the request-header allow-list) moved to packages/health-core/src/sentry-scrub-shape.test.ts; sentry-scrub-server.ts's header now names the freshness test. Left: the comments that still describe a hand copy in scrub-vocabulary.ts and instrument-scrub-parity.test.ts
